input: nums is a list of n safe-integer labels, with 0 <= n <= 20000; k is an integer in [0,20000]. Labels may repeat and may be negative. Empty input and k=0 are explicit extensions. Integer inputs are plain int values excluding bool. Containers are ordinary lists and strings are ordinary str values, without subclasses or overloaded behavior. No concurrent mutation or modified standard built-ins are allowed. Preconditions are not dynamically validated. Size bounds do not guarantee available memory or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: The exact number of nonempty contiguous subarrays containing exactly k distinct labels. Return 0 for k=0, empty nums, or more requested distinct labels than occur.
mutation_aliasing: Input values and order remain unchanged. Each helper call creates its own frequency map; there is no shared mutable state between the at-most windows or between invocations. The Solution instance retains no state; separate calls share no mutable result state.
numeric: Each at-most total, not just their difference, is at most n*(n+1)/2 <= 200010000. Counts and indices are bounded by n; k-1 may be -1 and is handled before scanning. Labels are compared/hashed, never arithmetically combined. All accumulator intermediates are exact safe integers.
complexity: Two O(n+1) sliding-window passes, with each endpoint advancing at most n times, assuming average map costs. O(min(n,k+1)+1) peak frequency storage includes the transient extra distinct label before shrinking. The first helper map need not be live during the second; total insert/delete work remains O(n+1). Map/set costs assume ordinary average O(1) operations after charging key construction/hash/comparison; no universal ECMAScript constant-time or adversarial collision-resistance guarantee is claimed.

helpers.name: at_most
helpers.contract: Count nonempty contiguous subarrays with at most limit distinct labels; a negative limit returns zero immediately. Shrink the left endpoint until the frequency-map size is admissible, then count every valid suffix ending at right.
